project.title: Isotope fractionation in biogas allows direct microbial community stability monitoring in anaerobic digestion
project.description: In this study, 13C isotope fractionation in CH4 and CO2 in the biogas was used as an early-warning method to monitor process stability of anaerobic digestion in response to salt stress.
